sources.title: Multimodal LLMs See Sentiment - GitHub
sources.snippet: MLLMsent is a research framework for investigating sentiment reasoning in MultiModal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It provides end-to-end tools for sentiment analysis from visual content, focusing on how images communicate sentiment through complex, scene-level semantics.

sources.title: Multimodal LLMs See Sentiment - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Among the potential advantages of this approach, we highlight its ability to express scene understanding through explicit textual descriptions, enabling the use of mature text-based sentiment models and improving interpretability, which is increasingly recognized as important in multimodal AI systems [9-13].

sources.title: Multimodal LLMs See Sentiment - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In summary, beyond seeing sentiment, our multimodal LLM (MLLMsent) establishes a new state-of-the-art while contributing to interpretability, as each prediction is accompanied by textual descriptions that help clarify the model's reasoning.
